words: G: "I've put credit on xAI. Use grok-4.7 as an outside scorer: every answer of the first batch, blinded as before, marked once with the scorer's instructions word for word, under version 1.1. It changes no score. ... The held-out items go to it only if it neither keeps nor trains on what is sent. Price it before running." G's answer, 14 November 2026: "Grok scores, with zero retention, which I'll switch on now." AG Opus: the edge set first, then the batch; the cap is G's credit.
zero_data_retention_read: Read by AG Opus in the xAI console, in G's browser, on 14 November 2026: the Studio G team's "Zero Data Retention (ZDR)" row reads "Active". Confirmed by G in the console the same day.
route: ordinary calls, never the batch service, which xAI does not offer under zero data retention
mark: the same fixed field as scorer one, offered as a function (AG Opus, 14 November 2026)
force_field_why: 14 November 2026: on the edge set, grok-4.7 left the field empty in 136 of 309 replies, and 27 of those named no mark at all. From here the mark field is required of it (tool_choice "required"), as the fixed field is how a scorer gives its mark. The 27 replies with no mark are asked again with the field required; both replies are kept.
